_note: Six contiguous face segments covering the full 50s. Karan is on camera throughout — these mark where the SETUP changes, not where he appears. Contiguous coverage is why the bottom of frame is never empty.

hook.line: Solid-state batteries have been two years away for ten years. Everyone assumed the holdup was chemistry.

reveal.line: It's not chemistry. It's pressure. ... So the lithium should lose.

mechanism.line: Researchers froze one mid-failure ... like a waterjet through rock. That's the short circuit.

turn.line: Not new chemistry. Better engineering. Tougher ceramic. Coatings. And tiny deliberate voids.

close.line: The problem was never the recipe. It was the pressure.
